Everything people write to us about — how long things take, what they're made of, and what happens if something isn't right. If your question isn't here, just ask us.

Orders & Shipping

Every Sunflora piece is hooked on demand, so nothing sits waiting on a shelf. Catalogue pieces are made and dispatched within 7–10 working days. Custom pieces take 5–14 days depending on how detailed they are — and we'll always share a timeline before we start.

Nothing at all. Shipping is free on every order, anywhere in India. The price you see on the tag is the price you pay.

Across India, to any pincode. We're not shipping internationally just yet — but if you're abroad and your heart is set on a piece, write to us and we'll see what we can do.

You'll get a tracking link by email the moment your piece is dispatched. You can also check any time on our Track Order page with your order number (it looks like ORD-A1B2C3D4) and the email you used at checkout.

Custom Orders

That's our favourite thing to do. A specific character, your pet, a bouquet in her exact wedding colours — bring us your strangest little idea and we'll hook it from scratch.

Four steps. You share your idea on the Custom Orders page — a photo, a doodle, a screenshot, anything helps. We come back with a design plan, a quote and a timeline. You approve and pay an advance, we make it, and the balance is due before it ships.

Absolutely. Send us a reference and we'll match it from our cotton library as closely as yarn allows. You'll always see a swatch photo and approve it before the first stitch.

Our standard sizes are 3 inch (7–8 cm), 5 inch (12–13 cm) and 12 inch (30–32 cm). Want something bigger? Just ask — more yarn and more hours, so the quote and timeline shift a little.

Payment, Returns & Care

UPI, credit and debit cards, and netbanking, all through a secure payment page. Every order is prepaid — we don't offer cash on delivery, since each piece is made especially for you. Custom orders start with an advance, with the balance due before dispatch.

Ready-made pieces from our catalogue can be returned within 7 days of delivery, unused and in their original packaging. Custom and personalised orders can't be returned — they were made for you, and only you.

Send us a photo on WhatsApp or email within 48 hours of delivery (your unboxing video helps, if you have one) and we'll repair or replace it. No fuss, no arguing.

Spot clean only — a damp cloth and a little mild soap. Never machine wash or soak it. Air dry flat, away from direct sun, and give it a gentle shake to fluff it back up after travel. Every parcel comes with a care card.

About Sunflora

Soft cotton yarn and safe polyfill stuffing, chosen piece by piece. All of it stitched by hand — no machines, no shortcuts.

Our standard pieces use securely fixed safety eyes and are best suited to ages 3+. For babies we make a fully baby-safe version with embroidered eyes and no plastic parts at all — just tell us when you order and we'll make yours that way.

Aru, mostly. One pair of hands, one hook, and a great many hours. Sunflora is a small studio — which is exactly why we work in small batches, and why your piece takes a little time.

Yes — wedding favours, return gifts, corporate hampers. Write to us with the quantity and the date you need them by, and we'll build a timeline that works. Bigger batches need more notice, so reach out early.
